segments.name: Real estate finance
segments.description: Originates, securitizes and manages a nationwide portfolio of real estate loans, mainly for small investors.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single reportable segment, conducting its business activities within the United States.

revenueModel.text: Earns interest and fees from real estate loans it originates, securitizes and manages for investors and small businesses.
revenueModel.evidence: We primarily originate investor loans secured by 1-4 unit residential rental properties, as well as loans for multi-family, mixed use and commercial properties.
